# @rxova/example

> A placeholder package from the template-oss repository template: `greet`
> returns a greeting for a name. Replace this summary with what the package
> does, who it is for, and its runtime requirements. Node >= 22.13. MIT. Ships
> ESM with type declarations.

## Install

    pnpm add @rxova/example

No peer dependencies.

## Minimal working example

```ts
import { greet } from "@rxova/example";

greet("Ada"); // "Hello, Ada."
greet("Ada", { excited: true }); // "Hello, Ada!"
```

## Mistakes to avoid

- An empty or whitespace-only name throws a `TypeError`; it does not return a
  greeting for nobody.

## API

| Export | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `greet` | function | `greet(name, { excited? })` returns `"Hello, <name>."`, or `!` when `excited` |
| `GreetOptions` | type | The options `greet` takes |

- [README](README.md): install and an example. Also in the tarball.
